subject: Fix swordfight RNG draw divergence (mislabeled VipIdleRemark cluster, ~80)
description: DONE at 960b156e3. The rng:VipIdleRemark cluster was a classifier artifact: VipIdleRemark/The16thFrame matched, while later offsets named UpdateSwordfightDistance, ReceiveSwordDamage, EvaluateSwordfight, FindPositionForTableSwordfight, and SwordDamageProtection. The common upstream cause was ReceiveSwordDamage's smalltalk DONE back-hit test. Original GetDirectionVector returns the isometric/aspect-scaled facing vector; Rust tested the raw unit-circle vector, flipping the half-plane result for diagonal facings. The resulting damage/protection draw skew perturbed later combat topology. Representative exact-EOF controls cover both Update offsets, table positioning, EvaluateSwordfight, and protection calls across old-schema nicouzouf S039 r009/r003, S037 r007, SuN1Sh1nE S024 r005 and schema-14 nicouzouf S024 r006, linux3 S013 r013, Cyrdach S001 r001. No independent distance/evaluate repro survived, so the existing spacing tolerance was not changed speculatively.
